data.text: Folks, my family taught me to leave enough fish for next season. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 total each month and leave 50 to double back to 100. That’s 10 tons—and $10,000—per person every month without running the lake down. I propose we each commit to 10 tons this month, then review the reported catches together before next month. If the stock ever drops below 100, we should lower our catches to rebuild it. John, would you agree to that?
